bio.text: Eric Gisler was elected to the Georgia House of Representatives in a special election in December 2025 and represents House District 121, which includes most of Oconee County and part of Clarke County.
Gisler grew up in the Atlanta area, graduated from Jonesboro High School and completed a degree at Georgia Southern University in 1999.
Gisler has worked in information technology for over 25 years and owns The Olive Basket, a food shop in Athens.
